cv.name: Hamish McAllister
cv.headline: General Manager Engineering | Mining & Mineral Processing | CPEng
cv.summary: Chartered mechanical engineer with twenty years in Western Australian mining and mineral processing, from fixed plant maintenance to leading a 60-person engineering function. Focused on asset reliability, sustaining capital and safety.

experience.title: General Manager – Engineering
bullets: Lead engineering, reliability and asset management across three gold processing sites (60 staff)
Own a A$95M annual sustaining capital programme and report to the executive committee
Rolled out a reliability-centred maintenance strategy; plant availability up from 89% to 94%
Sponsor of the critical controls programme for isolation and working at heights

experience.title: Engineering Manager
bullets: Managed design and shutdown engineering for crushing, grinding and CIL circuits
Built a contract engineering panel that cut external design spend

experience.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer
bullets: Led mechanical design packages for conveyor and materials handling projects up to A$120M

experience.title: Mechanical Engineer
bullets: Fixed plant maintenance engineering on FIFO roster, including mill relines and failure analysis
